labels.shortDescription: Gift import row rejected: appeal not found

labels.shortDescription: Gift import row rejected: more than one appeal matches

labels.shortDescription: Gift import row rejected: split percents do not total 100
labels.value: The split percents add up to {0}, not 100.

labels.shortDescription: Gift import row rejected: no payment method
